column5: One prepared positional VALUES INSERT over a configured clustered signed-BIGINT table lowers to typed Insert/NotExist mutations and reports one affected row per added record, matching insert_common.go's AddAffectedRows(1)-after-AddRecord ordering; a duplicate handle inside one statement fails before publication. INSERT SELECT, IGNORE, ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, SET syntax, REPLACE, defaults, auto-increment, generated/virtual columns, NULL and unsigned values, non-integer types, secondary/unique indexes, partitions, foreign keys, the Records/Duplicates/Warnings info message, plan cache, and statistics deltas remain open.

One prepared point UPDATE assigning a stored signed-BIGINT column by direct value or checked addition reads its own row at the transaction start timestamp and reports one affected row only when the value actually changes; a missing row and an unchanged row both publish nothing, matching write.go's changed/AddTouchedRows split under a session that never negotiates ClientFoundRows. Signed addition fails closed exactly where builtin_arithmetic.go's signed PLUS overflows. Multi-table update, ORDER BY/LIMIT, UPDATE IGNORE, general SET expressions, clustered-handle reassignment, matched-row bookkeeping and the Rows matched/Changed message, ClientFoundRows, indexes, partitions, and plan cache remain open.
